injuries.name: Anfernee Jennings
injuries.note: Jennings (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Jeff Nowak of The Big 870 New Orleans reports.

injuries.name: Kaden Elliss
injuries.note: Elliss (calf) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants, Jeff Nowak of The Big 870 New Orleans reports.

injuries.name: Alvin Kamara
injuries.note: Kamara (back) practiced on a limited basis Friday is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at the Giants, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Olave
injuries.note: Olave (illness) was limited at Friday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Week 6.

injuries.name: Jordyn Tyson
injuries.note: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Tyson (hamstring) is "progressing well" but isn't on track to return to practice this week, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.

injuries.name: Andrew Thomas
injuries.note: Thomas (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injuries.name: Colton Hood
injuries.note: Hood (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

injuries.name: Tyler Nubin
injuries.note: Nubin (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

injuries.name: Abdul Carter
injuries.note: Carter (calf) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injuries.name: Theo Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (neck) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injuries.name: Braxton Berrios
injuries.note: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Chauncey Golston
injuries.note: The Giants placed Golston (neck) on injured reserve Saturday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
